Climbing.description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Skills [2DAD1E690B1BC1EB4F3DCC3CB54D4FA5]", "Climbing_Description", "Climbing is older than walking upright: the apes we descend from lived in the trees, and the curved finger bones of Australopithecus kept their grip. Later peoples climbed rock for honey, eggs and a lookout - a painting in the Cuevas de la Arana in Spain, about 8,000 years old, shows a honey hunter climbing to a wild bees' nest. A practised climber reads the rock, trusts the feet and hangs on straight arms instead of pulling on bent ones.")
Climbing.howToIncrease: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Skills [2DAD1E690B1BC1EB4F3DCC3CB54D4FA5]", "Climbing_HowToIncrease", "Climb rock faces and tree trunks. Steep rock teaches more than a slab, and an overhang the most. Skill and a strong, lean body both make a climb cost less stamina and go faster.")
